relationships.subject: TRPV4
relationships.evidence_quote: TRPV4 is a common mediator of inflammatory responses induced by diverse crystals through NLRP3 inflammasome activation in macrophages.

relationships.subject: GSK219
relationships.evidence_quote: Application of a potent and selective TRPV4 activator GSK101 elicited a robust [Ca2+]i response in the synovial MΦs isolated from the Trpv4+/+ mice,28, 29 which was nearly abolished by GSK219 (figure 2a).

relationships.subject: MSU crystals
relationships.evidence_quote: Strikingly, both TRPV4 mRNA transcripts (figure 2f) and the number of TRPV4-eGFP+ cells were markedly increased in the joints 6 hrs after IA injections of MSU crystals (0.8 mg/site) (figure 2g and online supplemental figure 3c).

relationships.subject: TRPV1-expressing nociceptors
relationships.evidence_quote: the TRPV1-expressing nociceptors are required for MSU crystal-induced gouty arthritis through increasing TRPV4 expression, the number of synovial resident MΦs and the release of MΦ-derived cytokines.

relationships.subject: TRPV4
relationships.evidence_quote: Our data showed that TRPV4 is involved in the NLRP3 inflammasome activation induced by diverse crystals but not ATP and pore-forming toxins.

key_findings: TRPV4 in synovial resident macrophages is required for MSU crystal-induced gouty arthritis and for crystal-induced (not ATP/nigericin) NLRP3 inflammasome activation and IL-1β release
TRPV4 was not detected in DRG nociceptors; TRPV1+ nociceptor ablation reduced gout inflammation and macrophage TRPV4, indicating a neuroimmune loop
